summary: V27 (Master Live + Violations Auto-Cleanup + PlanUpgradeModal) tested. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passing — /api/admin/resellers-live returns 200 with query license_key for hours=1/24/168 and 403 without; /api/maintenance/violations/auto-cleanup returns 200 and is idempotent (second call deletes 0); all regression endpoints (plugin/status, plan/features=pro, blacklist/check, blacklist/requests, licenses list, POST /licenses/{id}/update) pass with no 500. Frontend: /panel/master-live renders correctly for master (header, 5 period buttons, 6 stat cards with data, search input, online-only checkbox, 1 reseller card — Test Bayi Ltd enterprise). PlanUpgradeModal code + wiring verified via code review (all data-testids present, ESC/backdrop/close handlers wired, redirects to /panel/pricing?upgrade=&cycle=). Could not runtime-trigger PlanUpgradeModal because master session has enterprise plan (PlanGate lets all features through). Daily cleanup cron task confirmed registered at server.py:466 with 2 grep hits for _daily_violations_cleanup_task, and 'Application startup complete' seen in backend logs after fixing an unrelated earlier indentation error (already resolved by main agent — backend now running clean).

minor.issue: Does not accept X-Master-Key HTTP header — only query param license_key. _is_master() at server.py:1884 reads license_key arg only. demo_write_guard (POST/PUT/DELETE) accepts X-Master-Key but GET master endpoints don't. Review request stated header should work. Suggest updating _is_master to also read request.headers.get('x-master-key').

ui_bugs.issue: Passes data-testid prop but StatCard component (ui-primitives.js:33) only accepts a `testid` prop, so the data-testid attribute is dropped. Stat cards render fine visually but automated testing cannot select them by data-testid=ml-stat-*. Fix: change prop name to testid, or update StatCard to spread data-testid.

action_items: (Optional) Make GET master endpoints accept X-Master-Key header in _is_master(). Currently only query license_key works. This is not blocking — frontend uses cookie auth.
Fix MasterLive.js StatCard usage: pass `testid` instead of `data-testid` (StatCard component only reads `testid` prop).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4723 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into modules (already partially done via routes/*.py).
_daily_violations_cleanup_task duplicates the logic in routes/maintenance.py::violations_auto_cleanup. Consider having the cron call the router function via _run_violations_cleanup helper (DRY).
PlanUpgradeModal has correct backdrop-click close via onClick={onClose} on outer + stopPropagation on inner — good pattern.
MasterLive uses 15s refetch interval — good, but consider pausing when tab hidden (visibilitychange) to save API calls.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing 'Test Bayi Ltd' reseller row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V27 backend fully green.
